datasets.name: geoBoundaries South Africa ADM2 (district municipalities)
datasets.role: Municipal boundary for spatially explicit aggregation
datasets.spatial_coverage: South Africa, ADM2; one feature extracted for eThekwini
known_gaps: Ward (ADM4) polygons are not published at this level; ward-level results are blocked
Boundary vintage 2020 may not match the Census 2022 ward geography
Source is a redistribution of MDB data, not the MDB release itself
processing_steps: Downloaded the ADM2 GeoJSON for ZAF from the geoBoundaries API
Extracted the single feature whose name contains 'eThekwini'
Validated geometry validity and computed area in EPSG:32736 (2,556.6 km2)
Wrote a normalised FeatureCollection with source, licence and vintage recorded

datasets.name: geoBoundaries South Africa ADM4 (wards)
datasets.role: Ward geometry for spatially explicit candidate-level results
datasets.spatial_coverage: South Africa, ADM4; 110 eThekwini wards extracted
known_gaps: Redistribution of MDB data, not the MDB release itself
Official ward codes are not carried; ward numbers are parsed from the feature name (eThekwini 001)
Vintage 2020 may not match Census 2022 ward geography; a crosswalk to census geography is still required
Ward layer tiles the municipality exactly (area difference 0.0 km2) but has not been reconciled against an independent ward list
processing_steps: Downloaded the ADM4 GeoJSON for ZAF from the geoBoundaries API
Selected the 110 features whose name begins with 'eThekwini'
Parsed ward numbers from the feature name and recorded the provenance of that code
Validated geometry validity, containment and area reconciliation against the ADM2 municipality
Persisted ward geometry and a ward-to-municipality crosswalk in the boundary tables

datasets.name: Daily maximum temperature, Open-Meteo archive (ERA5-derived)
datasets.licence: CC BY 4.0 (Open-Meteo); underlying reanalysis: Copernicus ERA5
datasets.crs: EPSG:4326 (point locations reported by the source)
datasets.native_resolution: 0.25 deg (~28 km), 5 grid points returned for eThekwini
known_gaps: Secondary distribution of ERA5, not the Copernicus CDS product itself; CDS adapter not implemented
0.25 deg resolution cannot resolve ward-level differences; results are reported per grid cell
Returned grid coordinates are snapped by the provider and are not exact 0.25 deg multiples
No missing days reported for this period; gap-filling behaviour of the provider is undocumented
The most recent 2-3 months of this feed are preliminary ERA5T and can be revised; the window ends at the last complete calendar year to stay outside that revision range (ADR-008)
processing_steps: Selected grid cells intersecting the eThekwini boundary
Requested daily temperature_2m_max for each cell, 1980-2025, local-day timezone
Recorded the provider's reported latitude/longitude as the data location
Stored raw JSON payloads immutably, then wrote a canonical Parquet table
Enforced unique (cell_id, date) and numeric coercion of missing values
